newsitem.title: UK: NWE SR fuel - Russian thined, but more coming.
newsitem.headline: NWE SR fuel - Russian thined, but more coming.

text.p: Russian straight run continues to be bought by traditional buyers of cracked.

"There's enough of it (M-100) around and so long as you don't pay a premium against cracked it makes sense," said one trader. Prices were pegged steady in line with a deal yesterday at $119.40 cif Ireland.
Dealers said supplies have been thinned by recent buying, but expected fresh material from Tuesday.
E-4 cargoes were not so readily offered and prices have kept firm around $133 cif NWE despite crude's rollercoaster ride.
Low sulphur straight run was steady in the low $140s, a deal yesterday at $156 cif Scandinavia reflecting the small size and 0.3 sulphur content.
